title: A strict, versioned fleet contract
heading: The Schema Is a Versioned Contract, Published as JSON Schema
cases: a version 3 document is accepted, and one with a key the schema does not declare is refused
a cost sent as the text "450" is refused, not converted
a flag sent as the text "yes" is refused, not converted
a version 2 document is upgraded: its garage becomes the depot and no bus is mandatory
upgrading renames what it knows and keeps everything else, so an unknown key is still refused
a version 2 document that already carries must_replace, or both garage and depot, is refused, not silently overwritten
a version 1 document is refused: there is no upgrade from it
